S.PHON: sua iiku ia kaʔaŋaina ʔaŋai
sua iiku ia kaʔaŋaina ʔaŋai

S.FORM: tia=ku pə-ʔə-ʔəna pu-isua nanala ʔusu miana.
S.PHON: tiaku pəʔəʔəna puisua nanaɾa ʔusu miana
tiaku peʔeʔena puisua nana[r|ɾ]a ʔusu miana
S.TRANSL: I shall talk about the orphan 'Usu in the past.

S.PHON: sua ʔusu ia nanaɾa kisaən
sua ʔusu ia nana[r|ɾ]a kisaen
S.TRANSL: There was a girl orphan named 'Usu.

S.FORM: miana ia, nuu tia=na=kaisisi vinaʔə ia, sua sa-saruanai tia=mu-a-sa nəmər-a, n<um>a-namarə mata ʔ<um>a-ʔanupu tia=ma-caʔə mara-kəra-kərapə.
S.PHON: miana ia nuu tianakaiʂiʂi vinaʔə ia sua sasaruanai tiamuasa nəməra numanamarə mata ʔumaʔanupu tiamaʦaʔə marakərakərapə
S.FORM: miana ia, nuu tianakaisisi vina'e ia, sua sasaruanai tiamuasa nemera, n<um>anamare mata '<um>a'anupu tiamaca'e marakerakerape.
S.PHON: miana ia nuu tianakaiʂiʂi vinaʔe ia sua sasa[r|ɾ]uanai tiamuasa neme[r|ɾ]a numanama[r|ɾ]e mata ʔumaʔanupu tiamaʦaʔe ma[r|ɾ]ake[r|ɾ]ake[r|ɾ]ape
S.TRANSL: To hold a millet festival in the past, men would go to a bush, burn it, and hunt for wild animals.

S.FORM: sua maanu ʔusu ia, ta-tiʔiŋ=pa mia-iisua
S.PHON: sua maanu ʔusu ia tatiʔiŋpa miaiisua
sua maanu ʔusu ia tatiʔiŋpa miaiisua
S.TRANSL: 'Usu was still a little girl at that time.

S.PHON: tatʂini maamia ʔakia mamaraŋin
tatʂini maamia ʔakia mama[r|ɾ]aŋin
S.TRANSL: She was alone by herself without her parents.

S.PHON: tiamaʔanman takutavaɾaʔə ʂiputukiakiau sasaruanai
tiamaʔanman takutava[r|ɾ]aʔe ʂiputukiakiau sasa[r|ɾ]uanai
S.TRANSL: She would like to learn to do men's work.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ma-kari-kari sa-saruanai ma-maraŋ-in, mata-cuvu-cuvuŋu pu-isua tia=kaisisi vinaʔə.
S.PHON: miaiisua makarikari sasaruanai mamaraŋin mataʦuvuʦuvuŋu puisua tiakaiʂiʂi vinaʔə
S.FORM: miaiisua makarikari sasaruanai mamarangin, matacuvucuvungu puisua tiakaisisi vina'e.
S.PHON: miaiisua maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i sasa[r|ɾ]uanai mama[r|ɾ]aŋin mataʦuvuʦuvuŋu puisua tiakaiʂiʂi vinaʔe
S.TRANSL: At that time the older men discussed and gathered together to talk about how they would hold a millet festival.

S.PHON: makarikariʦu tianummana numanamarə
maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]iʦu tianummana numanama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: They discussed when to burn (a bush).

S.FORM: ma-ti-rupaŋ=cu ma-maraŋ-in ma-kari-kari tia=nummana mu-kusa nəmər-a n<um>a-namarə.
S.PHON: matirupaŋʦu mamaraŋin makarikari tianummana mukusa nəməra numanamarə
S.FORM: matirupangcu mamarangin makarikari tianummana mukusa nemera n<um>anamare.
S.PHON: mati[r|ɾ]upaŋʦu mama[r|ɾ]aŋin maka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i tianummana mukusa neme[r|ɾ]a numanama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: The old men finished discussing when they would go to burn a bush.

S.FORM: sua mia-iisua ʔaisi ava t<um>a-timana nanala ʔusu tia=nummana sa-saruanai ʔ<um>a-ʔanupu mata n<um>a-namarə.
S.PHON: sua miaiisua ʔaiʂi ava tumatimana nanaɾa ʔusu tianummana sasaruanai ʔumaʔanupu mata numanamarə
S.FORM: sua miaiisua 'aisi ava t<um>atimana nanara 'usu tianummana sasaruanai '<um>a'anupu mata n<um>anamare.
S.PHON: sua miaiisua ʔaiʂi ava tumatimana nana[r|ɾ]a ʔusu tianummana sasa[r|ɾ]uanai ʔumaʔanupu mata numanama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: At that time the orphan 'Usu in fact heard when the men would go hunting and burn a bush.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mu-a-caanə=cu sa-saruanai musa nəmər-a, tia=cu n<um>a-namarə.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muaʦaanəʦu sasaruanai musa nəməra tiaʦu numanamarə
S.FORM: makasuacu muacaanecu sasaruanai musa nemera, tiacu n<um>anamare.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muaʦaaneʦu sasa[r|ɾ]uanai musa neme[r|ɾ]a tiaʦu numanama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: In that way the men went to a bush to burn it.

S.PHON: miaʦu araʦaini sua nipaiʦaa
miaʦu a[r|ɾ]aʦaini sua nipaiʦaa
S.TRANSL: Then they walked a long distance.

S.PHON: ʔuuna tatʂini mamaraŋin tinaraaiʔi ʦumaʦəʔəra
ʔuuna tatʂini mama[r|ɾ]aŋin tina[r|ɾ]aaiʔi ʦumaʦeʔe[r|ɾ]a

S.FORM: cəʔəra ʔinia ʔaisi ava ni-ki-papa nanala ʔusu.
S.PHON: ʦəʔəra ʔinia ʔaiʂi ava nikipapa nanaɾa ʔusu
ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]a ʔinia ʔaiʂi ava nikipapa nana[r|ɾ]a ʔusu
S.TRANSL: He found the orphan 'Usu actually following them.

S.FORM: t<in>aku-tavalaʔə ma-maraŋ-in, ni-ala-kulacə ma-maraŋ-in sua ʔusu.
S.PHON: tinakutavaɾaʔə mamaraŋin niaɾakuɾaʦə mamaraŋin sua ʔusu
tinakutava[r|ɾ]aʔe mama[r|ɾ]aŋin nia[r|ɾ]aku[r|ɾ]aʦe mama[r|ɾ]aŋin sua ʔusu
S.TRANSL: The older man found out and was angry with 'Usu.

S.FORM: "pu-aiʔ-a taanaasa. ʔakun ki-paapa kimia n<um>a-namarə si ta-tiʔiŋ=pa=kasu mata ma-nanakə=kasu."
S.PHON: puaiʔa taanaasa ʔakun kipaapa kimia numanamarə ʂi tatiʔiŋpakasu mata mananakəkasu
S.FORM: "puai'a taanaasa. 'akun kipaapa kimia n<um>anamare si tati'ingpakasu mata mananakekasu."
S.PHON: puaiʔa taanaasa ʔakun kipaapa kimia numanama[r|ɾ]e ʂi tatiʔiŋpakasu mata mananakekasu
S.TRANSL: "Go home! Don't follow us as we go to burn the bush because you're still too young and you're a girl."
